info.name: WeHelp APK Backend API (AWS EC2)
info.description:
# WeHelp APK Backend API (AWS EC2)

**Target URL:** `http://3.111.29.126`

This Postman Collection covers the end-to-end workflow for both **Field Agents** and **Administrators** as defined in the workflow diagram:
- **Authentication**: Role-based login (Admin/Agent) with JWT token auto-capture.
- **Admin Workflow**: Agent Creation, Real-time GPS Location Tracking, Leave & Week-Off Management, Payment Records Management, and Daily Targets.
- **Agent Workflow**: GPS Location Streaming, Cash & Product/Grocery Donation Logging, Attendance Check-In/Out, Daily Targets & Progress Tracking, and Leave Requests.

### ⚡ Quick Start:
1. Send the **Admin Login** request under `1. Authentication & Profile` to automatically set `{{admin_token}}`.
2. Send the **Agent Login** request under `1. Authentication & Profile` to automatically set `{{agent_token}}`.
3. You can now execute any Admin or Agent request in this collection seamlessly!
